title: computer_action
description: One GUI action for the computer-use loop. Coordinates are normalized to 0-999 on both axes and scaled to the actual screen at execution time.

x.description: Horizontal click target, 0 = left edge, 999 = right edge. Required for click/double_click/right_click/drag (drag start x).

y.description: Vertical click target, 0 = top edge, 999 = bottom edge. Required for click/double_click/right_click/drag (drag start y).

x2.description: Drag end x. Required only for drag.

y2.description: Drag end y. Required only for drag.

text.description: Literal text to type. Required only for type. Never send shell commands or credentials here.

key.description: xdotool key combination, e.g. 'Return', 'ctrl+l', 'alt+Tab'. Required only for key.

direction.description: Scroll direction. Required only for scroll.

thought.description: One short sentence explaining why this action advances the task.
